tiktok.author: chiefgyk3d
tiktok.body:
SystemD haters vs. years of love: It's easier for troubleshooting and timers are the future. Even AWS Linux ditched cron! #SystemD #Linux #TechExplained #DevLife #SysAdmin
Why do people hate system D? Um. Because it it goes against the Unix philosophy of do one thing and only one thing, and do that one thing extremely well. I understand why people have their animosity towards it, but after using it for several years, I've actually grown to love it and now prefer systemd over a init scripts because it's much easier to do troubleshooting. And now at the point where if you look my look at my git hub and if you see the timers that I make in a lot of my projects, they're usually systemd timers. They stopped doing cron jobs about a year ago. It's to the point now where if you use the latest version of AWS Linux and I think also the latest versions of Red Hat, they don't even come with Cron installed. You have to use systemd timers by default or install Cron. Have you tried Kshos? No I have not. Looks like it handles newer Intel Nvidia Blackwell GPUs, but not sure about what's best for playing anti cheat games or any work around.
